Job Title: Data Scientist
Experience: 2-5 years
Location: Hybrid: Bengaluru, 3 days a week in the office.
Mandatory Skills:
- Python
- pandas
Good to have:
- Apache Spark
- PyTorch

Responsibilities:
- Work within a cross-functional data team at a mid-stage fintech startup to design, develop and deploy data-driven models that improve customer segmentation, risk scoring and product personalization.
- Explore, clean and transform large transactional datasets using pandas and Python to generate features and prepare training datasets.
- Prototype, validate and iterate on statistical and machine learning models; implement model evaluation, backtesting and monitoring procedures.
- Collaborate with engineering to productionize models, ensuring reproducible pipelines, versioning and unit-tested code.
- Contribute to data architecture discussions; advise on when to adopt distributed processing tools and scalable solutions.
- Communicate findings and model impact to stakeholders through clear reports and presentations; translate business problems into data science tasks.
- Mentor junior analysts, review code and help establish best practices for data quality and model governance.
